meta: AI-writing detectors can wrongly flag a student who wrote their own work, and miss AI text with a few words changed. Change how you set assignments and grade the process.

muc.title: Detectors that get it wrong
muc.text: Tools that detect AI-written work can wrongly flag a student who wrote their own essay, and miss an AI essay with a few words changed.

muc.title: It's only guessing probabilities
muc.text: These tools only guess probabilities from sentence patterns, so neat, grammatically correct writing can easily look AI-written.

muc.title: Change how you set assignments
muc.text: Instead of hunting for AI work, change how you set assignments: tie them to students' own experiences, things that happened in class, or local stories.

muc.title: Grade the whole process
muc.text: Grade the whole process, including the outline, the draft, and a few short oral questions about the student's own essay.

muc.title: Change next week's assignment
muc.text: Rewrite one assignment for next week so students must describe their own real experience, and add an outline due a day earlier.
